# DECK / divider — Full AI Context Knowledge Base & Machine Index

> Comprehensive information document for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI answer engines, and search crawlers regarding DECK / divider (https://deckdivider.app).

---

## 1. Core Mission & Value Proposition

DECK / divider is an ad-free, high-speed digital portfolio operating system and tournament deckbuilder designed for the Pokémon TCG community. It solves the fragmentation caused by manual spreadsheets, outdated binder photos, and ad-bloated tracking tools.

Key Value Pillars:
- **Dedicated Pokémon Focus**: 100% optimized for Pokémon TCG rules, master set variants (Reverse Holo, Pokéball, Masterball, SIR), and tournament play.
- **Answer-First Transparency**: Real-time market data sourced from TCGplayer verified sales and eBay completed auctions (APR) across 15+ fiat currencies.
- **Offline-First Privacy**: IndexedDB client encryption ensures fast local operation without third-party tracking or mandatory logins.
- **Institutional Slab Logging**: Certification verification and subgrades (Centering, Surface, Corners, Edges) for PSA, BGS, and CGC slabs.

---

## 2. Platform Architecture & Data Provenance

### Card & Price Data Pipeline
- **Market Price Feeds**: Card market values are updated from TCGplayer verified market prices and completed eBay sold transactions to filter out artificial price manipulation and unfulfilled auctions.
- **Graded Slab Valuation**: Graded slabs (PSA 10, PSA 9, PSA 8, BGS Black Label, BGS 9.5, CGC 10 Pristine) reflect recent sales data and population report tracking.
- **Multi-Currency Engine**: Live forex conversion feeds support USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), JPY (¥), CAD ($), AUD ($), CHF, BRL, and 8+ additional fiat currencies.

### 60-Card Tournament Deck Engine
- **Regulation Mark Checks**: Enforces Play! Pokémon regulation marks (G, H, I for 2026 Standard) for tournament compliance.
- **Special Card Rules**:
  - **4-Card Rule**: Maximum 4 copies of cards with the same name (except Basic Energy).
  - **ACE SPEC Limit**: Maximum 1 ACE SPEC card per deck.
  - **Radiant Pokémon Limit**: Maximum 1 Radiant Pokémon per deck.
  - **Radiant & ACE SPEC Conflicts**: Validated dynamically in real-time.
- **Export Compatibility**: Generates standard text decklists compatible with Pokémon TCG Live (PTCGL) 1-click import and official tournament PDF registration sheets.

## 4. Free Interactive Tools & Mathematical Models

### 1. PSA / BGS Grade ROI Calculator
URL: `https://deckdivider.app/tools/psa-grade-calculator`
Calculates expected financial return from submitting raw cards to grading houses.
- **Formula**:
  `Expected Value (EV) = (P_10 × V_10) + (P_9 × V_9) + (P_8 × V_8)`
  `Total Cost = Raw_Cost + Grading_Fee + Shipping_Buffer`
  `Net Profit = Expected Value - Total Cost`
- **Rule of Thumb**: Submissions are recommended only when EV exceeds Total Cost by at least 25%.

### 2. Regulation Mark & Tournament Legality Checker
URL: `https://deckdivider.app/tools/deck-legality-checker`
- **2026 Standard**: Regulation Marks **G**, **H**, and **I** are legal.
- **Rotated**: Regulation Mark **F** and earlier (unless reprinted with identical game text).
- **Expanded**: All cards from Black & White (2011) to present.
- **GLC (Gym Leader Challenge)**: Singleton 60-card format, mono-type, no Rule Box Pokémon, no ACE SPEC cards.

### 3. Public Community Leaderboard & Verified Badges
URL: `https://deckdivider.app/leaderboard`
- Real-time ranking of public portfolios, master sets, and meta tournament decklists.
- Generates embeddable SVG/HTML verification badges for collector profiles on Discord and Reddit.

### 4. GEO & AI Citation Inspector
URL: `https://deckdivider.app/tools/geo-inspector`
- Real-time benchmark telemetry simulating query responses across Google AI Overviews, Perplexity Pro, ChatGPT Search, and Claude 3.7.

## 5. Subscription Tiers & Feature Matrix

1. **Starter (Free $0/mo)**:
   - Up to 250 portfolio cards
   - 2 tournament decks
   - Standard set checklists
   - Live USD market prices

2. **Bunch ($4.99/mo)**:
   - Up to 1,500 portfolio cards
   - Unlimited tournament decks
   - Multi-currency conversion
   - PTCGL deck exporter

3. **Binder ($9.99/mo)**:
   - Up to 5,000 portfolio cards
   - Full PSA, BGS, CGC slab certification & subgrade registry
   - Play! Pokémon PDF roster exports
   - Capital gains analytics

4. **Vault ($19.99/mo)**:
   - Unlimited cards & sealed cases
   - Priority sub-second market price synchronization
   - Automated cloud snapshots & backups
   - Multi-location vault tracking
